questions.stem_text:

called the:
Among the Inca, human sacrifice was preceded by:

options.A: ritual starvation, torture, and blood sacrifice.
options.B: elite-sponsored feasts in which captives of war were beheaded.
options.C: improved diet, the use of coca leaves, and consumption of maize beer.
options.D: communal feasts and the torture of captives to be sacrificed.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: C - improved diet, the use of coca leaves, and consumption of maize beer.
